name: ext-install-gui
description: Extension administration through the app's own surfaces only (user decision 2026-11-09): the Owner host installs fleet-sim from a package file and device-adapter from the run's signed static index (Browse), confirms both consent dialogs by their own buttons, disables one installation over the local `fe-ext admin` channel and re-enables it in the panel, then uninstalls both. The viewer only proves installations stay host-local; the Owner starts first and so owns the default admin endpoint, and a misrouted CLI verb would answer not-found rather than act on the viewer (tools/qa/sim/AGENTS.md section ext). No REST admin route is called; REST is used only to read the installation list.

steps.title: Preflight: the Owner is in the verse with no installation
Install fleet-sim from its package file; the consent dialog's own button confirms it
steps.note: The file field route (`via: file`) stages the run-packed .hexon; the panel shows `Enable org.example.fleet-sim` (consent needed), which ext_consent clicks.

expect.covers: R11 the consented file install is listed

steps.title: Install device-adapter from the signed static index (Browse row); consent in the dialog
steps.note: The Browse row `Install org.example.device-adapter <version>` comes from the run's index tree, verified against the pinned index key before it is offered (R-TOOL-23).

expect.covers: R11 the index install is listed beside the file install

steps.title: Disable over the local admin channel, re-enable in the panel
steps.note: ext_disable defaults to `channel: cli` (`fe-ext admin --json disable <installation>`); ext_enable with `channel: gui` presses the binding toggles on the row's Overview.

expect.covers: R23 the CLI verb reached this host

steps.title: Uninstall both through the two-step Uninstall / Confirm uninstall
